ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Macro-level ratio of approximately 1.6:1 high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white pixels dominate the central regions of both lobes. Low-intensity black pixels form a contiguous border at the peduncle junction and along the trailing edge perimeters. Discrete dark pixel clusters (mottling) are irregularly distributed across the white fields of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with an estimated interior angle of 35 degrees and a bounding-box depth approximately 12% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left lobe trailing edge displays low-frequency, low-amplitude (3-5 pixel) variations. Right lobe trailing edge exhibits higher frequency serrations and one distinct high-amplitude (approx. 50 pixel) concave indentation near the distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curvature extending from the median notch to the distal tips of both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of 8-10 high-contrast, circular dark-on-white pixel rings (rosettes) concentrated in the mid-region of the right lobe; scattered solid dark pixel clusters localized on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct irregular indentation/tissue loss on the upper distal margin of the right lobe; multiple circular rosette scars indicative of previous parasitic or barnacle attachment.
